title: Vintage DeJur D-1 35mm Film Camera w/ Staeble-Kata 1:2.8/45 Lens
descriptionText:
Step back in time with this vintage DeJur D-1 35mm film camera, featuring a Staeble-Kata 1:2.8 f=45mm lens. Manufactured in Germany, this classic camera is a fine example of mid-20th century design and craftsmanship.
The DeJur D-1 was marketed in the U.S. as an affordable, reliable 35mm camera for amateur photographers, and today it stands as a collectible piece of photographic history.
Features:
Model: DeJur D-1
Lens: Staeble-Kata 45mm f/2.8 (serial no. 524598)
Shutter speed dial on top plate
Manual film advance lever
Hot shoe for flash attachment
Textured leatherette body covering
Made in Germany
Condition:
Cosmetically in fair to good condition with some wear and scuffs consistent with age.
Shutter and mechanical parts untested (selling as-is, for parts, repair, or display).
Lens appears clear but may have minor dust.
Film compartment and rollers appear intact.
Please review all photos for details of condition.
Great for collectors, display, or restoration.
Item Specifics:
Brand: DeJur
Model: D-1
Film Format: 35mm
Lens Mount: Fixed Staeble-Kata 45mm f/2.8
Focus Type: Manual
Country of Manufacture: Germany
Condition: Used – Untested, sold as-is
